in_sanskrit.name: Badre
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Blessed One
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Badre एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Sanskrit, Badre means 'Blessed One'. This name is derived from the word 'Badh', meaning 'to bind' or 'to attach'. The suffix 're' signifies 'one who has'. Badre is a name that conveys a sense of divine blessings and connection to the divine.
